title: 第38章 肮脏的灵魂（求追读到最新~）
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
林知渔按着这篇新闻稿，找到了其他描写此类案件的稿子，都是四年前的了。

有的写着：二十七岁怀孕幼师即将领证结婚，却被四个未/成/年/折磨致死。死者家属当场否认，确认女子一切都是自愿的，但笔者却自以为事实并非如此，两百三十二万并非赔偿款，实为封口费。

究竟是因财而死，还是邪念害人？

看着牛魔王被他的法力包裹，他神色泰然，仿佛送出去的不是他安身立命的法力，只是一件微不足道的事物一般。

巧巧说得对，他得等孩子们回来，不然的话，孩子们以后会自责的。

他先是利用称臣纳贡，来换取苏哲的退兵，接着又把江北割给苏哲，利用苏哲来灭掉孙策。

李念惜不由得笑了笑，她不会告诉她，她刚刚悄悄给她用了一点缓解疼痛的药物。

只是想到对李辰然的承诺，她还是打算将纳妃一事与他说说。大臣们想要皇帝有后，最正常不过，可是，她知道，她也只能是说说，不会想着左右他任何决定。

赵云崨只知道两国正在交战，却并不知道情势已经紧张到极点，他脱口而出一股浓厚的缙朝南方人口音，瞬间让守卫眯起了双眼。

魏延一声豪烈狂笑，手中战刀舞动如风，狂风暴雨般的刀势，铺天盖地的轰斩而下，将关平笼罩在了层层叠叠的刀幕之中。

“你说，沧海吸入毒烟……入院？”霍靖琛机械的重复了一句，继而一步虚软，险些摔倒，下一秒，一道人影如鬼魅般，迅疾消失在众人视线。

张春华身儿一震，刹那间被问到哑口无言，不可思议的看着苏哲，鬓角竟渗出了一层冷汗。

苏哲却并没有直接入城，而是率一队兵马，绕过颍口，直接赶往了东门一带。

“我只是过来跟你说说，没事我先回去了。”张志国转身退出宿舍，顺手带上了门。

龙族总部神龙塔位于神山中央部位。此刻龙神塔议事厅内，五十多人齐聚一堂，个个脸色苍白，不知所措。

“好了，这个无聊的游戏我不玩了！我不想玩了！到此为止吧，乐乐！”没等乐乐开口，我已然狠狠地掐断了电话。

“好，不过，我很好奇，到时候你要怎么介绍我呢？”她看着夏晋远。

“能不能下次再进，我们一点准备都没有，起码配带几盏大灯进去，这样才看到里面的情况。”婉梦双手紧紧抓住林八方的衣角，在他背后，远远地看着前面一个未知的空间。

“哼，说得越动听越好，稍后本少爷定当百倍奉还！”穆西风眼中光芒闪烁，心中已有了计划。

下一刻，一道震彻天地的巨响震动开来，接着，在所有人骇然的目光中，八十一个混沌世界，竟是轰然破碎。

林八方听到戒指里面传黑龙的声音，他不禁吃一惊的，没有想到面前这只庞大的龙龟，只是吃了一滴龙血，就进化成这样子，要是喝了半杯龙血，岂不是进化得更厉害了？

童恩不知是该点头还是摇头，她没有动，嘴唇微张，轻笑了一下。

话是这么说，不过在方日归离开的时候，谢涛眉头紧锁，他总有些不安的感觉，说不上为什么。

在宽敞的公路上，三个男人都把悍马的油门踩到了底，从急速行驶的车中不时传出男人们兴奋地呼喊和慕容薇紧张的喝止，这样似乎有些疯狂，可是谁又在乎呢，男人，或许就应该疯狂一些。
content_en:
Lin Zhiyu followed this press release and found other manuscripts describing such cases, all from four years ago.

Some wrote: A 27-year-old pregnant kindergarten teacher was about to get married, but she was tortured to death by four minors.The family of the deceased denied it on the spot and confirmed that everything was done voluntarily by the woman. However, the author believed that this was not the case. The 2.32 million yuan was not compensation, but was actually hush money.

Did he die because of money, or did his evil thoughts harm others?

Seeing the Bull Demon King being wrapped in his magic power, he looked calm, as if what he sent out was not the magic power for him to live and settle down, but just an insignificant thing.

Qiaoqiao was right, he had to wait for the children to come back, otherwise, the children would blame themselves in the future.

He first used the title of vassal to pay tribute in exchange for Su Zhe's withdrawal. Then he ceded Jiangbei to Su Zhe and used Su Zhe to destroy Sun Ce.

Li Nianxi couldn't help but smile. She wouldn't tell her that she had just quietly given her some pain relief medicine.

Just thinking of her promise to Li Chenran, she still planned to talk to him about the concubine.It was normal for the ministers to want the emperor to have a wife, but she knew that she could only talk and would not try to influence any of his decisions.

Zhao Yun'e only knew that the two countries were at war, but he did not know that the situation had reached an extreme level. He blurted out a thick Jinchao southern accent, which instantly made the guard narrow his eyes.

Wei Yan let out a heroic laugh, and the sword in his hand danced like the wind. The force of the sword was like a violent storm, and it slashed down overwhelmingly, covering Guan Ping in layers of sword curtains.

"You said Canghai was admitted to the hospital after inhaling poisonous smoke?" Huo Jingchen repeated mechanically, then took a weak step and almost fell. The next second, a figure disappeared from everyone's sight like a ghost.

Zhang Chunhua was shocked and was speechless when asked. He looked at Su Zhe in disbelief, and a layer of cold sweat broke out on his temples.

However, Su Zhe did not enter the city directly. Instead, he led a group of soldiers and horses, bypassing Yingkou and rushed directly to the east gate area.

"I just came here to talk to you. If nothing happens, I'll go back first." Zhang Zhiguo turned around and exited the dormitory, closing the door behind him.

The Dragon Clan's headquarters, the Dragon Tower, is located in the center of the sacred mountain.At this moment, more than fifty people gathered in the meeting hall of Dragon God Tower, all of them looked pale and at a loss.

"Okay, I won't play this boring game! I don't want to play anymore! It's over here, Lele!" Before Lele could speak, I had already cut off the phone.

"Okay, but I'm curious, how will you introduce me then?" She looked at Xia Jinyuan.

"Can we go in again next time? We are not prepared at all. At least we can go in with a few big lights so that we can see what's going on inside." Wan Meng tightly grasped the corners of Lin Bafang's clothes with both hands and looked behind him at an unknown space in front of her from a distance.

"Hmph, the more pleasant you say it, the better. I will pay you back a hundred times later!" Mu Xifeng's eyes flashed with light, and he already had a plan in mind.

The next moment, a loud noise shook the world, and then, in everyone's horrified eyes, eighty-one chaotic worlds were shattered.

When Lin Bafang heard the sound of the black dragon coming from the ring, he couldn't help but be surprised. He didn't expect that the huge dragon turtle in front of him would evolve into this after just eating a drop of dragon blood. If he drank half a cup of dragon blood, wouldn't it evolve even more?

Tong En didn't know whether to nod or shake her head. She didn't move, her lips opened slightly, and she chuckled.

That's what he said, but when Fang Rigui left, Xie Tao frowned. He always felt a little uneasy, and he couldn't explain why.

On the spacious road, the three men all stepped on the Hummer's accelerator. From time to time, the men's excited shouts and Murong Wei's nervous shouts came from the fast-moving car. This seemed a bit crazy, but who cares? Men, maybe they should be a little crazy.
